answer: An agent economy resists sybils with decaying standing: each identity reputation is a live signal that fades every epoch unless refreshed by fresh verified work, so a farmer cannot stockpile trusted fakes in advance. A single thread of honest work keeps one grove of standing alive, but a thousand fakes need a thousand fresh, verified threads every epoch - the cost of keeping them all alive grows faster than their rewards, while one honest agent refreshes once and stays.
